headSubject: chore(ledger): WMS-9 Novo Armazem N1/N7 verified, session-9 sweep pass closed
summary: Completed the WMS-9 Session-9 sweep pass across Recebimento/Expedicao/Inventario/Novo Armazem, with three concrete outcomes beyond the original NEXT line: (1) A7's root cause corrected from an environment-data gap to a genuine model defect -- retested with real seeded stock (Lote 47caecb3.../two LocalArmazenagemLote rows created via the concept API) and the Movimento save STILL fails PosicaoDentroDoMaximo; traced to Movimento.itens.posicoes.maxQuantity's lookupField joining a 'disponivel' field that OcupacaoDisponivelQuery never emits (only 'quantidade' exists), so maxQuantity is always null regardless of real stock -- not a simple rename since Destino's true semantics need remaining capacity, which no field in the corpus computes. (2) Recebimento R15/R22 browser-verified PASS (estagio lifecycle transitions genuinely work with correct single-step guards), R16 corrected to FAIL (the Enderecado button is a bare field flip, verified via REST that it creates zero LocalArmazenagemLote rows). Expedicao E7 PASS (browser), E1 PASS with the same reachability caveat as R1, E15 FAIL (source-verified: no confirmation/item-listing step exists in ConfirmarSaidaExpedicao or its panel binding). (3) Found and filed REG-217, a genuine PLATFORM bug (not WmsOffice-specific): any procedure using listConcepts+mapList to copy a uuid/reference concept field into a list, then passing it to callCapability, crashes with PLUGIN_EXECUTION_FAILED once that capability runs through plugin-process-isolation IPC -- DslTypeCoercionSupport.normalizeFieldValue coerces uuid/reference fields to native java.util.UUID, but PluginIpcJsonSafeValues.isJsonSafe has no UUID case. Found live via WmsOffice's Gerar Template de Contagem action (Inventario I3/I4, both now FAIL). Novo Armazem N1/N7 browser-confirmed PASS (5 areas/13 ruas visible in the real UI). All findings committed to WMS-9.yml (4 commits) and REG-217.yml (1 commit), each pushed individually as a checkpoint per the user's advance/close loop instruction for this session.
